asset.name: Complaint acknowledgement
asset.description: Sent to the customer as soon as the complaint is logged.
asset.subject: We have received your complaint ({{complaint_ref}})
asset.html_body:
We are on it

Dear {{contact_name}},

Thank you for telling us about this. We are sorry it happened. Your complaint about {{form.category}} ("{{form.summary}}") has been logged and a named person is now looking after it.

We will contact you within {{ack_hours}} hours and aim to resolve it by {{=FORMAT_DATE(resolve_by, "DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm")}} UTC.

Your account manager, {{account_manager}}, has been kept informed.

Kind regards,
Customer care

Reference {{complaint_ref}} · please quote it if you get in touch
asset.text_body: Dear {{contact_name}}, we have received your complaint about {{form.category}} ("{{form.summary}}"). We will contact you within {{ack_hours}} hours and aim to resolve it by {{resolve_by}}. Reference {{complaint_ref}}.
